name: Jordan Rivera
summary: Operations coordinator with experience organising community workshops and supporting a busy service team. Turns scattered requests into clear schedules, practical instructions and reliable handovers. Comfortable learning new tools and asking the questions needed to keep work moving.

experience.description: Community workshop network running a weekly programme of sessions.
bullets: Coordinated bookings, materials and volunteer rotas for a weekly programme of community workshops.
Created a shared booking checklist and handover notes so colleagues could see outstanding tasks and take over cover shifts.
Worked with facilitators to identify access requirements and resolve changes before sessions.
Helped two new volunteers learn the booking process; responsibility covered task guidance rather than line management.

experience.description: Independent repair shop for household electronics.
bullets: Handled customer enquiries, recorded repair requirements and kept customers informed when plans changed.
Maintained a shared spreadsheet of open requests and prepared clear handovers between shifts.
Collected recurring questions and drafted a short reference guide for the team.
